title: Keep it safe
headline: Keep it *safe*
sub: Approvals for money going out, and the app lock.

recap.en: Money is going out and coming in. How does Zainab keep it safe?
recap.pcm: Money dey go out, money dey come in. How Zainab go keep am safe?

flow.purpose: she asks to pay the supplier
flow.action: Looks at her phone, bites her lip, taps Send, then looks across at Zainab, who is at the cutting table
flow.setting: Zuri Atelier workroom, Surulere: a bright room, a cutting table with bolts of Ankara in indigo, gold and green, two sewing machines, a rack of finished outfits in plastic covers, a mirror with a fitting platform, a window on a yellow-painted wall

flow.action: Reads her phone, checks the amount, nods and taps once with a firm smile
flow.setting: Zuri Atelier workroom, Surulere: a bright room, a cutting table with bolts of Ankara in indigo, gold and green, two sewing machines, a rack of finished outfits in plastic covers, a mirror with a fitting platform, a window on a yellow-painted wall

flow.action: Stands in the workroom doorway in the evening light, looks back at the busy room and smiles with quiet pride
flow.setting: Zuri Atelier workroom at dusk, warm lamp light, the rack full of finished outfits

en: Dami asks to pay Alhaja Sade.
Zainab sees who asks, what for, and how much.
She taps Approve. First payment to this account: check the details.
She adds a comment. It is recorded with her decision.
Approve again, and the card clears.
pcm: Dami ask make she pay Alhaja Sade.
Zainab see who ask, wetin for, and how much.
She tap Approve. Na first payment to this account: check the details.
She add comment. E go dey record with her decision.
Approve again, and the card go clear.

en: Zainab turns on the app lock.
In Settings, she taps App lock.
She can choose when it asks: at once, or after a while.
Later, Taskiem is locked until she proves it is her.
Fingerprint matched, and she carries on.
pcm: Zainab turn on the app lock.
For Settings, she tap App lock.
The phone dey check her fingerprint.
She fit choose when e go ask: at once, or after small time.
Later, Taskiem go lock until she prove say na her.
